05 / FINISHING TOUCHES

Considered,
down to the details.

The Acacia finishing specifications, room by room. Expand each item to explore what is included.

01Entry foyer+

Marble floors. Painted walls and ceiling.

02Living & dining+

Marble floors. Painted walls and ceiling.

03Master & secondary bedrooms+

Marble / porcelain tile floors. Painted walls and ceiling. Wardrobes are not included.

04Kitchen+

Porcelain tile floors. Painted walls and ceiling. Cabinets and appliances are not included.

05Terraces+

Accessible terraces: marble / porcelain tiles. Inaccessible terraces: gravel.

06Utility, nanny’s & driver’s rooms+

Ceramic tile floors. Painted walls; ceramic tiles for bathroom walls. Painted ceilings.

07Bathrooms+

Marble / porcelain tiles to floors and walls. Painted ceilings.

08Sanitary ware & fittings+

High quality sanitary fixtures: Duravit or similar. High quality mixers: Grohe or similar. Shower cabinets, water heaters and bathroom accessories.

09Doors+

Entrance: solid wood. Internal doors: pressed wood with veneer.

10Air conditioning+

Concealed AC units for living, dining and bedrooms. Vent fans for bathrooms, if applicable.

11Aluminium & glazing+

Double glazing for living, dining and bedrooms. Single glazing for bathrooms, kitchen and utility. Shutters are not included.

12Electrical & connectivity+

All internal works including main panels, switches, covers and built-in spotlights. Triple Play provisions, excluding modems and service activation.
